holes.headline: See exactly where your shots go here
holes.sub: Connect your handicap and every round you've played at this course becomes a hole-by-hole breakdown - your worst holes, your doubles, where your round slips.
holes.slim: See where your shots go on this course

about.headline: See how you measure up here
about.sub: Connect your handicap to see your scoring average at this course against members, your friends and the course record.

profile.headline: Your handicap belongs here
profile.sub: Connect once and your index, your trend and every round you play appear on your profile automatically - no manual logging, ever.
profile.slim: Add your handicap to your profile

champions.headline: Seven crowns at this club
champions.sub: Connect your handicap and every round you play here counts automatically - no logging, no admin. Take a crown and your name sits on the board.
champions.slim: Play for the crowns at this club

verifiedAccounts.title: Verified accounts
verifiedAccounts.body: We verify golfers and professionals ourselves - there's nothing to apply for. If you're seeking verification, contact support and we'll take a look. If you represent a club, brand or business, set up a business page and you can request verification there.
